answer: What survives to the spiral is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The vertex is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the prism. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, published publicly on failure, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
